ideas.pitch: Real-time commuter incident forecasting and crowd-sourced bus crowding prediction platform tailored for Hamilton's HSR network, using predictive statistical models to help students avoid delayed routes.
ideas.title: HamiltonTransit Pulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting local utility and infrastructure needs always resonates strongly with judges at regional Canadian hackathons like DeltaHacks.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered meal recommendation and nutritional deficit tracker designed specifically for university dining hall menus, helping students maintain healthy eating habits on a tight student budget.
ideas.title: CampusCare AI Nutrition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediately relatable everyday problem for the majority of the student-heavy audience and judging panel.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-imagery-based industrial land compliance tracker focused on local industrial zones in Ontario, using computer vision to flag environmental rule violations or unauthorized expansion.
ideas.title: EcoAudit Hamilton
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex technical integration of geospatial data and computer vision within a compact hackathon timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent video intelligence platform that ingests unstructured lecture recordings and automatically generates searchable transcripts, interactive flashcards, and conceptual knowledge graphs.
ideas.title: LectureLens AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student productivity, making it easy for peers and judges to understand and test the product immediately.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous peer-to-peer service marketplace for university students using secure escrow transactions to facilitate campus freelance gigs without platform commissions.
ideas.title: LocalLedger Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Incorporates modern transaction flow engineering that appeals to judges looking for functional, end-to-end payment products.
